_meanings:
²1 To talk to, address; {#mEtasmin saMvadizwA atizWAH#} <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 1. 2</ls>.
.²2 To speak together, converse, discourse.
.²3 To resemble, tally with, correspond to, be like (with <ab>instr.</ab>); {#asya#}
 {#muKaM sItAyA muKacandreRa saMvadatyeva#} <ls>U. 4</ls>; {#aho saMvadantyakzarARi#} <ls>Mu. 5</ls>.
.²4 To name, call.
.²5 To agree, accord, consent.
.²6 To coincide, fit together (so as to give one sense).

.²1 To consult, hold consultation (with <ab>instr.</ab>); as in {#mOhUrtikEH saha saMvAdyatAm#}.
.²2 To cause to sound, play upon (a musical instrument).
.²3 To declare (truly or sincerely); {#saMvAdya rUpasaMKyAdIn svAmI taddravyamarhati#} <ls>Ms. 8. 31</ls>.
